map.由线膨胀系数求伸长量 使用指南: Elongation from Linear Expansion Coefficient User Guide
map.输入线膨胀系数α、原长L与温差ΔT，按 ΔL = α·L·ΔT 计算材料受热后的: Enter the linear expansion coefficient α, original length L and temperature difference ΔT and compute elongation as ΔL = α·L·ΔT, for thermal expansion compensation and fit design.
ΔL = α·L·ΔT. Steel α = 1.2e-5, L = 2 m, ΔT = 100 -> 2.4 mm.
map.输入线膨胀系数 α、原长 L、温差 ΔT，求伸长量。: Enter the linear expansion coefficient α, original length L and temperature difference ΔT to get elongation.
map.算温变引起的长度变化: Compute length change from temperature variation
map.：ΔL = alpha * L0 * ΔT。钢 alpha≈12e-6/°C、长: : ΔL = alpha × L0 × ΔT. Steel alpha ≈ 12e-6/°C, length 10 m heated 50 °C: ΔL = 12e-6 × 10 × 50 = 0.006 m = 6 mm, so an expansion joint is needed.
map.：单晶/复合材料各方向 alpha 不同，可能引起翘曲；各向同性材料各向相同。: : single crystals and composites have different alpha by direction and may warp; isotropic materials are the same in all directions.

map.为什么轨道要留缝？: Why do rails need expansion gaps?
map.温升伸长量大（千米级累积数厘米），不释放会拱起；故用伸缩缝或无缝线路预应力补偿。: Temperature rise produces large elongation (centimeters over kilometers); if not released it buckles, hence expansion joints or prestress compensation in continuous welded rail.
map.alpha 为负什么意思？: What does a negative alpha mean?
map.少数材料（如锑、某些陶瓷）升温收缩（负膨胀），可用于精密尺寸稳定复合材料。: A few materials (such as antimony and some ceramics) shrink when heated (negative expansion), useful in composites for precision dimensional stability.
